name: smart-assistant-ai-studio-root
description: Root runner for AI Studio previews. The production Vite app remains in frontend/ and Netlify continues to build from frontend/.

scripts.dev: npm --prefix frontend ci && npm --prefix frontend run dev -- --host 0.0.0.0
scripts.start: npm --prefix frontend ci && npm --prefix frontend run dev -- --host 0.0.0.0
scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend ci && npm --prefix frontend run build
